response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior engineer with 15+ years of production software experience, current hands-on exposure to MCP servers and agentic tooling, and solid TypeScript/Node.js and cloud (AWS CDK) skills. However, he falls well short of the core requirement of 8+ years building AI-driven solutions — his GenAI experience appears to span only about a year — and the resume shows no evidence of RAG architectures, vector databases, LLM evaluation pipelines, or data pipeline expertise for AI workloads, all of which are central to this staff-level FDE role.
strengths: Current hands-on experience with MCP code generators and agentic-workflow infrastructure
Deep production engineering background across TypeScript, Node.js, cloud, and high-scale systems
Demonstrated mentorship and knowledge-sharing (workshops, courses, open-source leadership)
concerns: Roughly 1 year of GenAI experience versus the required 8+ years of AI-driven development
No demonstrated RAG, vector database, or LLM evaluation/observability experience
Limited evidence of customer-facing technical discovery or enterprise delivery leadership
